purpose: Local Metin2 perception taxonomy for replacing GPT-per-frame vision with detector/OCR/OpenCV structured state.

selected_target_name.validation_rule: combat target is valid only if target_name contains Metin

mob_name_labels.validation_rule: reject Metin candidates overlapping known mob labels

feedback_assertions.move_forward: coordinate delta must be non-zero or minimap/player/world optical flow must change; otherwise diagnose stuck/focus/menu/key ignored
feedback_assertions.camera_turn: world view must rotate while coordinate stays roughly stable
feedback_assertions.attack: target HP must decrease, hit animation must appear, or target must disappear; otherwise abandon stale/wrong target
feedback_assertions.click_target: selected target name/HP must appear and validate as Metin before trusting attacks

recommended_loop: run local detector/OCR/OpenCV into structured state JSON
apply deterministic feedback assertion for previous action
log screenshot/state/action/feedback for GPT review only on failures
